title: Type Schema
description: A code generation friendly representation of FHIR StructureDefinition and FHIR Schema designed to simplify SDK resource classes/types generation.

name.description: Computer friendly identifier for the element

url.description: A canonical URL identifying this resource uniquely in the FHIR ecosystem

with-primitive-type-kind.description: Constraint helper to ensure the kind is primitive-type

with-valueset-kind.description: Constraint helper to ensure the kind is value-set

with-binding-kind.description: Constraint helper to ensure the kind is value-set

with-complex-type-kind.description: Constraint helper to ensure the kind is complex-type

with-resource-kind.description: Constraint helper to ensure the kind is resource

with-nested-kind.description: Constraint helper to ensure the kind is nested

with-logical-kind.description: Constraint helper to ensure the kind is logical

field.regular.title: Regular field
field.regular.description: A standard field with a single type

type.description: The data type of this field

reference.description: Reference targets, split into two independent facts: base resource types a reference literal may point at, and profile conformance expectations from targetProfile

resource.description: Base resource types a reference value may point at; profile targets are resolved to their base specialization and deduplicated

profiles.description: Profile conformance expectations from targetProfile — reference values in instances always use base resource types

required.description: Whether this field must be provided in valid instances

excluded.description: Whether this field is prohibited in valid instances

array.description: Whether this field can contain multiple values (cardinality > 1)

enum.description: For code fields, the set of valid values when bound to a required value set

min.description: Minimum limit of items for an array

max.description: Maximum limit of items for an array

field.polymorphic-declaration.title: Polymorphic value[x] field declaration
field.polymorphic-declaration.description: The base declaration for a FHIR choice type (e.g., value[x])

choices.description: The names of all concrete type options for this choice field

required.description: Whether at least one choice must be provided

array.description: Whether the selected choice can contain multiple values

min.description: Minimum limit of items for an array

max.description: Maximum limit of items for an array

field.polymorphic-instance.title: Polymorphic value[x] field instance
field.polymorphic-instance.description: A specific type option for a FHIR choice type (e.g., valueString, valueInteger)

choiceOf.description: The name of the choice field this instance belongs to (e.g., 'value' for valueString)

type.description: The data type of this choice option

required.description: Whether this specific choice must be provided

excluded.description: Whether this specific choice is prohibited

array.description: Whether this choice can contain multiple values

reference.description: Reference to other types that this field can point to

binding.description: For coded choices, information about the value set binding

enum.description: For code fields, the set of valid values when bound to a required value set

min.description: Minimum limit of items for an array

max.description: Maximum limit of items for an array

dependencies.description: Other types that this type depends on

slice-match.title: Slice match
slice-match.description: How a slice is recognized in instance data. 'value' holds the discriminator values keyed by element name and is used verbatim for runtime matching; 'kind' says whether they come from fixed/pattern discriminator values ('value') or a resource-type discriminator ('type')

field-slice.title: Field slice
field-slice.description: One slice of a sliced element. Besides the source facts, profile snapshots carry derived facts computed at snapshot build so generators share one implementation

min.description: Minimum number of elements matching this slice

max.description: Maximum number of elements matching this slice (0 = unbounded)

required.description: Required sub-element names inside a matched element

excluded.description: Prohibited sub-element names inside a matched element

nameCandidates.description: Collision-free name candidates for generated accessors

effectiveRequired.description: Derived (profile snapshots): 'required' minus match keys and choice-declaration base names — the sub-elements validators must check

constrainedChoice.description: Derived (profile snapshots): the single choice variant this slice constrains (e.g. BP component value[x] narrowed to valueQuantity)

autoStub.description: Derived (profile snapshots): the slice can be auto-populated with just the discriminator match values

resourceType.description: Derived (profile snapshots): matched resource type for type-discriminated slices (e.g. Bundle entry -> Patient)

field-slicing.title: Field slicing
field-slicing.description: Slicing definition for one sliced element, keyed by field name in the schema-level 'slicing' map — kept apart from 'fields': fields describe the data shape, slicing is an independent constraint layer

oneOf.title: Type Schema for Primitive Type
oneOf.description: Schema for basic FHIR data types like string, boolean, decimal

identifier.description: The unique identifier for this primitive type

description.description: Human-readable description of the primitive type

base.description: The base type this primitive type extends (typically Element)

dependencies.description: Other types that this primitive type depends on

oneOf.title: Type Schema for Resource, Complex Type, Logical
oneOf.description: Schema for FHIR resources, complex types, and logical types

identifier.description: The unique identifier for this resource or type

base.description: The base type this resource or type extends

description.description: Human-readable description of the resource or type

fields.description: The fields contained in this resource or type

slicing.description: Slicing definitions keyed by field name, kept apart from 'fields'

nested.description: BackboneElement types nested within this resource or type

identifier.description: The unique identifier for this nested type

base.description: The base type this nested type extends (typically BackboneElement)

fields.description: The fields contained in this nested type

slicing.description: Slicing definitions keyed by field name, kept apart from 'fields'

dependencies.description: Other types that this resource or type depends on

oneOf.title: Type Schema for ValueSet
oneOf.description: Schema for FHIR value sets that define terminology bindings

identifier.description: The unique identifier for this value set

description.description: Human-readable description of the value set

concept.description: The list of coded concepts contained in this value set

display.description: The human-readable display text for this code

system.description: The code system URL that defines this code

compose.description: Complex value set composition rules when the value set is defined as a composition of other value sets

identifier.description: The unique identifier for this value set

description.description: Human-readable description of the value set

enum.description: The enumeration of values for the binding

dependencies.description: Other types that this resource or type depends on
